materials.title: 2026年6月六级 第1套 Conversation One

checks.question: What is the relationship between the two speakers?

options.A: A boss and an employee discussing how to get promoted
options.B: A program host and a career development consultant
options.C: Two coworkers complaining about their manager
options.D: A job interviewer and a candidate in a job interview

checks.question: The man mentions a common belief that working hard creates a good impression. What is the woman's response?

options.A: She confirms it, adding that constantly staying late shows commitment
options.B: She agrees the belief does not always hold, and argues that effective, focused effort matters more than simply logging longer hours
options.C: She suggests setting high expectations at the beginning to impress others
options.D: She recommends taking on more work so that the results can prove one's effort

checks.question: Under what condition does the woman recommend helping colleagues with their projects?

options.A: Whenever colleagues ask for help with their projects, even if her own work would be left unattended
options.B: Provided that helping them would not leave her own work neglected
options.C: Only after she has completed her own work for the day
options.D: Only when the colleagues asking for help are less senior than her

materials.title: 2026年6月六级 第2套 Conversation One

checks.question: What problem is the man facing?

options.A: His request for annual leave has not been approved
options.B: He almost forgot about the upcoming anniversary
options.C: He has settled on Barcelona as the destination, but cannot find accommodation there that is both available and reasonably priced
options.D: The cheaper accommodation further up the coast has already been fully booked as well

checks.question: What is the man's accommodation plan by the end of the conversation?

options.A: Book a glamorous hotel in the city for the whole week
options.B: Spend a couple of nights somewhere glamorous, then the rest of the week further up the coast
options.C: Book an all-inclusive place inside the city of Barcelona
options.D: Give up the trip because everything is fully booked

checks.question: Why does the man decide against going up the cathedral tower?

options.A: Because he is terrified of heights himself
options.B: Because Jane is terrified of heights
options.C: Because the spiral staircase is still under construction
options.D: Because the climb up would take too much time
